occurrences.fixedText: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

wikiRead.title: Gehenna
wikiRead.identityBasisJa: JOS15:8と18:16はヒンノムの谷を境界描写に明記。記事は名称・ヨシュア記15:8を扱うが、厳密範囲に複数説を示す。
wikiRead.resultJa: Gehenna記事の識別・現代地理節を実読。ヨシュア記15:8、境界文脈、正確な谷位置の複数説を確認。

geographyJa: エルサレム南側の谷とする地図上の用法が一般的ですが、聖書本文における谷の正確な範囲には複数の解釈があります。旧索引点は未確認候補としてのみ保持します。
